# pivi app protocol, version 2

JSON-RPC 2.0 over the container entrypoint’s stdin/stdout, one UTF-8 JSON message per line. stderr is the log stream; nothing else may be written to stdout.

Features an app can declare in its manifest: `dashboard`, `screen`, `playback`, `skipSegments`, `chat`.
The host only sends a request or notification whose feature the manifest declares, and drops
what an app sends without declaring its feature. Methods without a feature are always on.

Every message is validated on arrival, so respect the size caps in `src/limits.ts`.

## Overview

| Method | Direction | Kind | Feature |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `app/ready` | app → host | notification | always |
| `host/activate` | host → app | notification | always |
| `host/locale` | host → app | notification | always |
| `host/shutdown` | host → app | notification | always |
| `app/publishDashboard` | app → host | notification | `dashboard` |
| `host/refreshDashboard` | host → app | notification | `dashboard` |
| `app/publishScreen` | app → host | notification | `screen` |
| `app/openOnPhone` | app → host | notification | `screen` |
| `host/uiEvent` | host → app | notification | `screen` |
| `host/ping` | host → app | request | always |
| `app/resolveStream` | host → app | request | `playback` |
| `app/resolveSkipSegments` | host → app | request | `skipSegments` |
| `app/resolveNext` | host → app | request | `playback` |
| `app/resolveLiveStatus` | host → app | request | `playback` |
| `host/openChat` | host → app | notification | `chat` |
| `host/closeChat` | host → app | notification | `chat` |
| `app/chatMessages` | app → host | notification | `chat` |

In `defineApp`, notifications and requests from the host are handlers, and the app → host
notifications are methods of the returned context.

## Methods

### `app/ready`

From app, notification. First message, sent once the app can receive requests. Nothing else is sent to it before.

Params:

```ts
type Params = {
  protocol: number;
}
```

### `host/activate`

From host, notification. Sent once after ready: the app may start publishing.

Params:

```ts
type Params = {
  locale: string;
}
```

### `host/locale`

From host, notification. The host language changed since activate. Same params.

Params:

```ts
type Params = {
  locale: string;
}
```

### `host/shutdown`

From host, notification. The app should exit. It is killed shortly after regardless.

### `app/publishDashboard`

From app, notification, feature `dashboard`. The cards this app contributes to the home dashboard. Replaces the last set.

Params:

```ts
type Params = {
  cards: ({
    kind: "resume";
    id: string;
    title: string;
    subtitle: string;
    image: string;
    fallbackImage?: string;
    progress: number;
    action: {
      type: "screen";
      screenId: string;
    } | {
      type: "session";
      sessionId: string;
      context?: string;
    } | {
      type: "openOnPhone";
      url: string;
    };
  } | {
    kind: "suggestion";
    id: string;
    title: string;
    meta: string;
    image: string;
    fallbackImage?: string;
    action: {
      type: "screen";
      screenId: string;
    } | {
      type: "session";
      sessionId: string;
      context?: string;
    } | {
      type: "openOnPhone";
      url: string;
    };
  })[];
}
```

### `host/refreshDashboard`

From host, notification, feature `dashboard`. The home screen was opened. Publish the dashboard again with fresh content if it can go stale.

### `app/openOnPhone`

From app, notification, feature `screen`. Ask the paired phone to open an https link, e.g. a sign-in page. The phone asks the user first. Ignored without a connected phone, and when sent more than once every few seconds.

Params:

```ts
type Params = {
  url: string;
}
```

### `host/uiEvent`

From host, notification, feature `screen`. The user interacted with a node of a published screen that carried an event id.

Params:

```ts
type Params = {
  screenId: string;
  eventId: string;
  value?: string | boolean;
}
```

### `host/ping`

From host, request. Sent after another request timed out. Answer right away, any response will do. An app that does not answer is stopped.

### `app/resolveStream`

From host, request, feature `playback`. Resolve a session id to a playable stream. URLs must be on a domain the manifest declares.

Params:

```ts
type Params = {
  sessionId: string;
  maxHeight?: number;
}
```

Result:

```ts
type Result = {
  videoUrl: string;
  audioUrl?: string;
  vcodec: string;
  acodec?: string;
  videoContainer: "mp4" | "webm" | "hls";
  audioContainer?: "mp4" | "webm";
  title: string;
  duration: number;
  live?: boolean;
  qualities?: number[];
  subtitleTracks?: ({
    language: string;
    label?: string;
    kind: "caption" | "transcription";
    url: string;
    format: "vtt";
  })[];
  controls?: {
    seek?: boolean;
    seekButtons?: boolean;
    playPause?: boolean;
    volume?: boolean;
    subtitles?: boolean;
    quality?: boolean;
  };
  chat?: boolean;
}
```

### `app/resolveSkipSegments`

From host, request, feature `skipSegments`. Skippable stretches of a session’s stream.

Params:

```ts
type Params = {
  sessionId: string;
}
```

Result:

```ts
type Result = {
  segments: ({
    startSeconds: number;
    endSeconds: number;
    label: string;
  })[];
}
```

### `app/resolveNext`

From host, request, feature `playback`. The session to play after this one ended, from the context its action carried. Optional, answer with no sessionId when there is none.

Params:

```ts
type Params = {
  sessionId: string;
  context?: string;
}
```

Result:

```ts
type Result = {
  sessionId?: string;
}
```

### `app/resolveLiveStatus`

From host, request, feature `playback`. Current figures for a live session, polled while its player is open. Answer with an empty object when there is nothing to report.

Params:

```ts
type Params = {
  sessionId: string;
}
```

Result:

```ts
type Result = {
  viewers?: number;
}
```

### `host/openChat`

From host, notification, feature `chat`. A player started showing the chat of a session whose stream had `chat: true`. Start sending app/chatMessages for it.

Params:

```ts
type Params = {
  sessionId: string;
}
```

### `host/closeChat`

From host, notification, feature `chat`. Nobody shows this session’s chat anymore. Stop sending messages for it.

Params:

```ts
type Params = {
  sessionId: string;
}
```

### `app/chatMessages`

From app, notification, feature `chat`. New messages of an open chat, oldest first, batched a few times a second at most, plus what moderators removed since the last batch (applied to earlier lines; leave affected lines out of the batch itself). Ignored for chats that are not open.

Params:

```ts
type Params = {
  sessionId: string;
  messages: ({
    id: string;
    author: string;
    authorId?: string;
    color?: string;
    parts: ({
      type: "text";
      text: string;
    } | {
      type: "emote";
      name: string;
      url: string;
    })[];
  })[];
  removed?: {
    ids?: string[];
    authorIds?: string[];
    all?: boolean;
  };
}
```
